title: Pure Time Thief
summary: Time Thief cards only, with generic Rank 4s, Links and staples. Time Thief is a Rank 4 Xyz deck that steals cards to use as material. Time Thief Winder searches any Time Thief card, and Time Thief Regulator tributes itself for two more Time Thief monsters from the Deck. Two Level 4s make Time Thief Redoer, which attaches their top card every Standby Phase. It then detaches a Monster, Spell or Trap material to dodge removal, draw, or spin their card to the top of their Deck. Time Thief Double Barrel answers their activations by detaching the same three material types. Time Thief Power Reserve, the newest card, summons itself as a Level 4 and brings out a Machine Time Thief. With a Spell and a Trap attached to an Xyz, it banishes a card from the GY.
main: Time Thief Winder
Starter: searches any Time Thief card; summons itself by detaching a material.
Time Thief Regulator
Tributes itself for two Time Thief monsters from the Deck.
Time Thief Adjuster
Summons itself after a Time Thief summon; mills a Time Thief card.
Time Thief Bezel Ship
Attaches a card from their GY; revives by detaching a material.
Time Thief Temporwhal
Banishes their monster until the End Phase; revives itself.
Time Thief Chronocorder
Reflects battle damage; revives when an Xyz leaves the field.
Time Thief Startup
Quick-Play: summons a Time Thief; attaches a Monster, Spell and Trap from the GY.
Time Thief Hack
Protects new Xyz Monsters; pumps an Xyz to attack directly.
Time Thief Flyback
Attaches a Time Thief card from the Deck, or a card from their GY.
Time Thief Retrograde
Counter Trap: negates a Spell/Trap and attaches it.
Time Thief Power Reserve
Newest Trap Monster: summons a Machine Time Thief; banishes a card from the GY.
